programme.title: Disaster DIY
programme.desc: Tony Armstrong is the king of temporary fixes. He has a large kitchen (and a large family) that needs some permanent solutions. Can Bryan help Tony learn how to do the job right, once and for all.

programme.title: Disaster DIY
programme.desc: Ed and Jocelyn want to add to their living space by closing in their deck. DIY guy Jocelyn has made a complete mess with makeshift fixes like covering it in plastic sheeting.

programme.title: Disaster DIY
programme.desc: Bob has a handyman father-in-law who wants Bob to do the best for his daughter, Laura. Bob doesn’t know the first thing about renovation but tried his hand at it anyway, and made a huge mess of their small bathroom.

programme.title: Disaster DIY
programme.desc: Les wants to sit and enjoy his time at his vacation home, but the deck he built out of found lumber and old pallets is falling apart and is a hazard to walk on! What was supposed to be a relaxing spot is now a headache.

programme.title: Disaster DIY
programme.desc: Greg and Tracey have bought their first house and it’s a real fixer-upper. Greg thinks that he’s up to the task, but he’s made a real mess of his dining and living room. Can Bryan give Greg the know-how?

programme.title: Disaster DIY
programme.desc: Bill’s wife Joan has been reluctant to let him renovate the kitchen, because the ‘thrifty’ renovations he has done in the past were poorly done, using leftover materials, badly fitted into the space.

programme.title: Disaster DIY
programme.desc: 22-year-old Scott promised his mother he’d renovate her basement, so he could move in and save money for a new place. He’s started, but he’s so wet behind the ears that he doesn’t know where to turn next.

programme.title: House of Bryan
programme.desc: Pumped about the prospect of building a family cottage of his very own, Bryan’s learning the hard way the importance of location, location, location!

programme.title: House of Bryan
programme.desc: The build has just begun and two of Bryan’s worst fears are becoming a reality – rainy weather and plan changes!

programme.title: House of Bryan
programme.desc: Bryan’s belief that building at the cottage all summer would be relaxing have been anything but! Burning the candle at both ends has taken its toll and Bryan’s down for the count at a critical stage in the build.

programme.title: Income Property
programme.desc: Julie and Andy intend to renovate the existing income suite in their new home. They just can’t make it happen. They have demanding careers and no renovation experience. They need Scott’s skills and reno savvy.

programme.title: Income Property
programme.desc: Jennifer and In-Suk experienced a financial setback. With Jennifer on maternity leave and In-Suk unemployed for the last seven months, this couple needs an income suite to offset their mortgage costs.

programme.title: Income Property
programme.desc: Evelyn and Armel had an energy audit and now they’re racking up debt in order to make smart improvements to their home. They need the income from an apartment to help out with the costs of renovating for the long-term.

programme.title: Income Property
programme.desc: Allison and Rob’s income dipped due to a career change and maternity leave. Luckily, they have an income suite in their basement that can help them maintain their great standard of living.

programme.title: Income Property
programme.desc: Lise will be 63 years old when her 35-year mortgage is finally paid off. With an basement income suite, she could be mortgage free in 13 years, at 39! Scott will help set Lise on the path to financial freedom.

programme.title: Income Property
programme.desc: Alice is living under a gold mine: a two story apartment above her own apartment that’s fallen into disrepair. Alice wants it to be perfect but she doesn’t trust anyone and doesn’t know what she wants.

programme.title: Income Property
programme.desc: Anne and her sister, Karin, bought their duplex from their landlord a couple of years ago. Now, Karin has unexpectedly fallen in love and she's moving out. That leaves Anne with a full mortgage to pay.

programme.title: Income Property
programme.desc: Marsha and Ellwood married 4 years ago bringing two kids each to their blended home and a future with three college educations to consider.

programme.title: Income Property
programme.desc: Victoria and Evan are young, smart and ambitious. Two years ago, the pair started a business together with offices in two separate cities.

programme.title: Income Property
programme.desc: With first time homeowner budgets in mind and clever design ideas, Scott will deliver smart and simple rental suites.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Ice Cream: Deedle dee dee! Dora and Boots hear the ice cream truck nearby, but they just miss it.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Choo Choo: All aboard! It's time for the big train race. First train to the Big Yellow Station wins a big whistle.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Berry Hunt: Dora and Boots go hunting for blueberries on Blueberry Hill. But they'll have to be careful--Swiper the fox lives on Blueberry Hill!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: WizzleWishes: Dora and Boots meet Wizzle who lost his bag of wishes and can't get home. Our heroes, Dora and Boots, set off in search of the lost wishes.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Bishop to Knight: The guys are shocked to find that their old archenemy, Agent Bishop, is alive and well in the year 2105. And worse, he's President of the Pan-Galactic Council?!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Night of Sh'Okanabo: When Mikey finds out that Cody has never seen a horror flick, our boisterous movie aficionado drags Cody and his three brothers downtown for a little horror movie festival viewing.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Clash of the Turtle Titans: Mikey is shocked to discover someone has taken over his old super hero persona TURTLE TITAN. Insane with jealousy, Mikey tries to put the kibosh on the 22nd century imposter.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Fly Me to the Moon: Cody and the Turtles go to the moon in search of a rare lunar alloy. But their quest is cut short when they discover that the Inuwashi Gunjin have been sent there by Darius Dun to make sure that they never come back alive.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
